evidence.limitations: Requires attacker control of the plugin repository and relevant client/configuration. Inspection is not exploit reproduction; broad product exposure and deployment prevalence are not independently verified. The original explicitly limits hash-shaped branch attacks: GitHub rejects those branch names. AIR reports fixed Claude Code and Codex versions; its separate Gemini variant differs. Do not repeat universal current vulnerability claims.
